description: A deploy script for UWP that generates an AppxManifest.xml file using templates and configuration parameters.

methods.name: _GenerateAppxManifestContent
methods.description: Generates the content of the AppxManifest.xml by assembling application sections and rendering a template with version info.

methods.name: _WriteAppxManifest
methods.description: Writes the generated AppxManifest content to a file with file locking and retries.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and initiates the process to generate and write the AppxManifest.
